subject: history
concept: Understanding globalization: how technology and trade have connected the world's nations and economies
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student traces where the parts of an everyday object (like a phone) come from around the world
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a global connection (internet, shipping, communication) to how it links distant places
exercise.abstract: Student explains one way globalization connects people or economies across the world today

misconception_flags: believes goods and information mostly stay within one country's borders today

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
